STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE ### 1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS - **No inline CSS:** the `style="..."` attribute is forbidden anywhere in the HTML. Inline event-handler attributes (`onclick`, etc.) are equally forbidden. - **Class/ID selectors only:** every design property, layout rule, and state lives in `style.css`, targeted via class or ID selectors. - **Minimal HTML modifications:** markup stays semantic and style-agnostic (landmarks: `header`, `nav`, `main`, `section`, `footer`; one `h1`; `h2` per section; `h3` for cards). Re-theming the site must require editing `style.css` only. ### 1.2 CSS Variables & Theme Tokens - All tokens in §0.2 must be defined in `:root` and consumed via `var(--...)`. No raw hex values in component rules — only inside `:root` and gradients composed from tokens. - **Contrast pairing:** every dark background token pairs with light text tokens; every light-filled element (amber buttons, badges, monogram avatars) carries dark text (`#050B26`). Verify ≥4.5:1 for body text, ≥3:1 for large text and UI components. - **Light-mode background rule (`#fefefe`):** void for this theme — see the dark-only exception in §1.3. ### 1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode Support — Dark-Only Exception - Dark mode is mandatory and fully satisfied here: the dark thermal palette is the single, unconditional global theme defined in `:root`, with `color-scheme: dark` declared so native controls and scrollbars match. - **Exception (per style spec: Light ✗ / Dark ✓ Full):** this theme is dark-only. Do not define light-mode tokens, a theme toggle, or `localStorage` persistence. The page must render identically regardless of the OS `prefers-color-scheme`. ### 1.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First Alignment - Build all layout structures with Flexbox. **Every flex container defaults to `align-items: center`** unless an exception is explicitly justified in a CSS comment. - **Mobile-first:** single-column stacks by default; row layouts added at `min-width` breakpoints (~768px, ~1024px). No horizontal scrolling at any viewport from 320px up. Fluid type via `clamp()`. Content container: max-width ~1200px, centered. - Anchor targets get `scroll-margin-top` so the sticky header never covers section headings. ### 1.5 Framework & Styling Approach - Use Tailwind CSS **or** clean custom CSS organized with Tailwind-style `@layer`/`@apply` conventions. Given this theme's bespoke HUD effects, hand-authored component CSS in `style.css` is the expected approach. - Utilities must map back to CSS variables; generic reusable classes `.btn`, `.card`, `.input-group` must exist and be reused across all instances. ### 1.6 Typography & Icons (Google Fonts Mandatory) - **Text:** load `Share Tech Mono` from Google Fonts via `` (with `preconnect`) and bind it to `--font-base`. Headings, body copy, and HUD labels all use it (fallback: `'Courier New', monospace`). Any additional typeface must also come from Google Fonts. - **Icons:** Google Material Symbols (Outlined) via the official Google Fonts stylesheet. Usage: `thermostat`. **Inline SVGs and local icon files are forbidden.** --- ## 2.
